notes: Bit (BIT) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.1.0 ERC20 in src/Bit.sol. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 100,000,000 BIT (100000000000000000000000000 base units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory. There is no owner, no further mint, no public burn, no transfer fee, no pause, no blacklist, no seizure and no upgrade path, so the supply is fixed for the life of the deployment and every transfer delivers exactly the requested amount; the factory, the pool manager, the launch's MerkleDistributor and ordinary traders need no exemptions. The launch deploys no application contracts and makes no initialization calls. The pool pairs BIT with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (3,500 IMD for the whole supply) and the token's supply and address. Per the requester's economics, 80% of the supply seeds the single-sided pool and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0x206f5dbf4f135c6183b5a5b99327fa0be34cb4d9; the swarm's 10% is taken by the factory and sent to the distributor before the pool is seeded.
